description: The time-trial ghost look (JetSkiModel.ghost) on a hull scene: test/craft/hull_preview.tscn shows the code-built hull, the generated hull and the generated hull as a ghost. The ghost's hull scene meshes are drawn see-through by hull_paint_ghost.gdshader, after the water (render priority 1) and without shadows, still in the rider's colours; the other generated hull is drawn by hull_paint.gdshader with shadows.

steps.name: the generated hull is painted and casts shadows
the ghost's hull and handlebar are see-through and drawn after the water
no part of the ghost casts a shadow
the ghost keeps the rider's colours
the ghost's rider sits at the seat it was given
